title: Finger Aids
description: Finger splints, cots, and thumb supports for mallet finger, fractures, finger joint protection, and post-surgical rehabilitation.

products.name: Finger Cot
features: Soft silicone or fabric sleeve that encloses the finger
Seamless construction prevents pressure marks
Available in three sizes to fit different finger diameters
Reusable and easy to clean
benefits: Protects injured or post-operative fingers from further trauma
Provides gentle compression to minimise localised swelling
Keeps dressings secure without restricting adjacent finger movement
Suitable for use during daily activities and light work

products.name: Frog Splint
features: Dorsal aluminium stay with foam padding holds the PIP joint in extension
Perforated design allows skin to breathe
Velcro strap secures the splint without excessive pressure
Low profile sits flat against the finger
benefits: Maintains PIP joint extension for boutonniere deformity management
Prevents further volar plate stretching during healing
Allows DIP joint movement to prevent stiffness
Commonly prescribed by hand therapists for finger joint injuries

products.name: Finger Mallet
features: Rigid dorsal shell holds the DIP joint in full extension
Contoured to prevent skin maceration under the splint
Vented surface for airflow to the fingertip
Secure velcro strap with easy one-hand application
benefits: Immobilises the DIP joint to allow mallet finger tendon repair
Prevents DIP joint flexion that would rupture the healing extensor tendon
Enables full PIP joint movement so adjacent joints remain mobile
Essential for conservative management of mallet finger injuries

products.name: Splint Finger
features: Aluminium stay with foam lining provides rigid support
Can be shaped to the required angle for joint positioning
Velcro strap secures without constricting blood flow
Lightweight and slim for discreet wear
benefits: Immobilises finger fractures in the correct healing position
Used post-surgery to protect repaired tendons or ligaments
Prevents unwanted joint motion that could delay recovery
Suitable for both acute injury management and longer-term rehabilitation

products.name: Thumb Spica Splint
features: Rigid thumb post immobilises the CMC and MCP joints
Padded inner surface prevents pressure sores at bony prominences
Wrist strap anchors the splint securely to the forearm
Open finger design keeps the remaining fingers free
benefits: Immobilises the thumb for gamekeeper's thumb, De Quervain's, and CMC arthritis
Reduces pain during pinch and grip by offloading the thumb joint
Protects the thumb after UCL repair or ligament reconstruction
Preserves hand function by keeping the index and remaining fingers mobile
